notes: Upright manuscript sheet with author page number 8 at the top and a thin lower-left archive foliation 80 in another unnamed hand. It has two principal prose blocks, two main displays, a short marginal identity, and several additions and cancellations. No diagram or drawing is present.

The opening continues a statement that a point x in X_K is determined by its class f_{x_0,x}, hence by a chosen cocycle f_l; an equivalent g construction is written using the inverse path. The first f_{x_0,x} on the prose line was cancelled and repeated in the display.
The first display has an underbrace only under (X,x_0), with a hatted capital Pi(x_0) annotation. That visibly restricted brace is retained although a broader semantic grouping might seem natural.

The main paragraph discusses what explicit determination of f_l should mean when Gamma is far from connu et à la main. It proposes specifying u by its values under the previously mentioned generator invariants. It inserts finite and the arrows l_j:x_j to y_j. The page ends with an unfinished parenthetical description of J and I; nothing beyond the visible final comma is supplied.
The margin reads f_l=(g_{l^{-1}})^{-1}. The live g cohomology formula has no separate outer inverse: its sole -1 belongs to the path index. This comparison was a transcription consistency check only.

No proof, independent derivation, computation, certificate, or mathematical background assertion was used as a checked result. The injectivity/determination assertion and the relation of cocycles are only transcribed here. check_events is therefore empty.

The whole image was viewed once and the top and bottom native-resolution halves once each. Ten tight crops were made from original pixels and inspected; all have rotation 0. No OCR, image-to-text process, internet research or TeX compilation was used.

All five assigned MARKS rows are represented. M0328 and M0330 remain undecided in place. The old cancelled x_0 and the cancelled wording after Comme were also examined though not assigned MARKS rows. Certainty-only resolutions are separated in certainty_decisions.

The lower-case forms in H are repeatedly contradicted by capital-shaped Pi ink. A broad cancellation after Comme and an overwritten superscript remain the least secure textual regions; their candidate readings must not be taken as resolved.

Root reviewed all 21 crop files and the page inventory. The isolated glyph remains 4/pilcrow unresolved. The two cancelled clusters after Comme are retained separately without supplying an unseen a. Raised 1-cocycle has explicit uncertainty about insertion state. No proof check was performed on this page.
